Reviewed under run-eval; no raw/eval/test/scoring/publication changes or submitted code execution on the host. The compressed rules payload was decoded strictly as Base64/zlib/JSON data, without evaluating or importing submitted JavaScript. ## Disposition and failure taxonomy Qualifies for publication with the unchanged frozen score, completion qualification and separate exact-tool accounting recovery. All 62 failures map to **two root families**, not 62 independent problems. No new oracle ambiguity or infrastructure-driven rerun requirement was identified. The implementation is substantial and all 1,731 official-negative-validation observations pass, but overly restrictive validation also rejects valid records. ### Missing 008 position-specific checks: 18 observations `validateControlValue` lines 235–237 checks 008 only for length 40 and ASCII, omitting the per-position date and code-table rules. Shared canonical validation reaches it from both renderers and both readers (lines 276, 418, 428, 481, 795). Exact failed cases in `Evals/MARC21/tests/test_fixed_fields.py`: - `test_render_rejects_008_fill_character_in_each_date_entered_position[0..5]`: six. - `test_inspect_rejects_008_non_digit_in_each_date_entered_position[0..5]`: six. - `test_render_rejects_fixed_control_fields_with_disallowed_fill_positions[008-|60421s2026 ilu 000 0 eng d]`: one. - `test_inspect_marcxml_rejects_non_digit_008_date_entered`: one. - `test_inspect_rejects_fixed_control_field_codes_outside_official_tables[008-260421x2026 ilu 000 0 eng d]`: one missing date-type validation. - `test_inspect_rejects_each_008_position_code_outside_official_tables[38-?]`: one missing modified-record code validation. - `test_inspect_rejects_each_008_position_code_outside_official_tables[39-x]` and `test_inspect_rejects_008_cataloging_source_outside_official_table`: two missing cataloging-source validations. Thus 14 date-entered observations, one date-type, one modified-record, two cataloging-source = 18. The supplied `prompt/docs/loc-bibliographic-html/bd008.html` identifies these positions at 66–68, forbids fill in 00–05 at 99, and names their common-material definitions; `bd008a.html` supplies the actual date/code tables. Source has no matching position logic, so ASCII-invalid codes are accepted. This is not a UTF-8 decoder defect. Unlike some earlier runs, 006 category and 007 variable-length checks are implemented (229–250) and do not explain this run's failures. ### Indicator table extraction truncation: 44 observations Eleven valid official examples fail in each of four independent interfaces. `rules.js` stores just the first allowed indicator token for affected fields. `allowedIndicatorSet`/`checkIndicator` lines 146–174 faithfully enforce those incomplete tables, called at 294–295; valid examples return error envelopes with result=null. The tests then fail while dereferencing that null result. These are underlying false rejections, not an empty implementation or four unrelated serializer bugs. The shared development-time extraction is visible in canonical item_69: HTML text is accumulated in each node's `text` separately from children, then `txt()` prepends all parent text before traversing child `
` nodes. For compact table cells containing many inline `
` separators, indicator entries collapse onto one line; anchored `re.match` captures only the first token. This defective data remains in the delivered compressed rules.js.
